newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM Cargo signs express mail deal with EMS.
newsitem.headline: KLM Cargo signs express mail deal with EMS.

text.p: Express Mail Services (EMS), the European joint venture for express post, has extended its contract with KLM Cargo for a further three years.
The latest edition of the KLM staff magazine Volgeridder said both companies expected the number of individual mail consignments to double in the next three years to more than 300,000.
EMS, which is responsible for the express mail of 40 European post offices, is a joint venture of European national post offices which co-operate as part of the Swiss-based European Postal Union.
The article said KLM Cargo was an obvious choice for EMS because a large proportion of express mail passed through Schiphol airport en route to other destinations.
KLM Cargo, part of KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV, is the largest carrier resident at the leading Dutch airport.
